questions.question: How should I re-dispatch the 41 unfinished agents?

options.label: Waves of ~6, sequenced (Recommended)
options.description: Launch 6 background agents, wait for completions, then next 6. ~7 waves, each ~5-10 min wall. Total ~45-60 min. Conservative on rate limits, still mostly parallel. I drive the cadence.

options.label: Waves of ~12, more aggressive
options.description: Faster (3-4 waves) but more likely to hit the same rate-limit wall partway through. May leave more half-finished worktrees.

options.label: Sequential, one at a time
options.description: Safest — no rate-limit risk. But slow: 41 × ~3-5 min = 2-3 hours, mostly idle wall time.

options.label: Pause until rate limit clears, then waves of ~10
options.description: Wait ~15 min, then larger waves. Bet that the burst caused the throttle and a cooldown unblocks bigger fan-out.

questions.question: Anything to fix in the brief before re-dispatching?

options.label: Add 'check if doc already committed on this branch, skip if so'
options.description: Idempotency guard — if an agent retries, it won't redo work. Useful if waves overlap or if you re-dispatch after partial progress.

options.label: Add 'rate-limit retry: if you hit a rate-limit, wait 60s and retry once'
options.description: Helps agents self-recover from brief throttles instead of giving up entirely.

options.label: Add 'on completion, also use SendMessage to ping main thread with one-liner'
options.description: Better visibility into per-agent finish vs only seeing notifications. Slightly noisier.

options.label: No changes — brief is fine
options.description: Re-dispatch with the existing brief unchanged.

- **1 ticket done**: dstrader#33 (PR template) — `76eb34e` on `mb-33-pr-template` worktree, codex-reviewed, ready for inspection.
- **37 empty worktrees + branches** created on disk before the rate-limit hit. Re-dispatching agents can `cd` straight in (the brief handles "worktree already exists").
- **4 not even started** (no worktree on disk): dstrader-docker #19 (DEPLOYMENT), ai-harness #23 (INTEGRATIONS), ai-harness #25 (subsystem-RC), ai-harness #26 (PR template).

Root cause: the Anthropic API server-rate-limited the 42-burst within ~60s. Per harness guidance I shouldn't retry-loop blindly. Need a smaller fan-out.
